internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across 31 of 36 occurrences the root names 'a piece of what is said/told' — an account, report, statement or tidings (the noun HadiyT) and, as a verb (Form II), 'to tell/recount it to someone.' It covers the account of Moses, the guests of Abraham, the best discourse (the Book), idle talk, a confided secret, a fabricated account and the most truthful speech alike. A separate 5-occurrence Form-IV family (>uHodiTa/yuHodiTu 'bring newly into being' and muHodaT 'freshly produced') means origination, not telling, and even brings forth a non-verbal 'affair' (>amr, 65:1). The Quran never uses Form IV to mean 'narrate' nor the noun to mean 'a newly-made thing', so the two families are reported as distinct and the unifying 'newness/coming-to-be' idea is left unresolved rather than forced.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: The discourse-family contribution does NOT entail: (1) truth or falsity — it spans HadiyTFA yufotaraY (fabricated, 12:111) and >aSodaqu ... HadiyTFA (most truthful, 4:87); (2) novelty/recency — HadiyTu muwsaY (20:9, 79:15) and jaEalonaAhum >aHaAdiyTa (made into old bywords, 34:19/23:44) are non-new; (3) medium — it applies to a written kitaAb (>aHosana AlHadiyTi, 39:23) and to the earth's oral report (99:4); (4) register — neutral across revelation, secrets (66:3) and idle chatter (31:6); (5) the act of conversing itself — that is carried by other verbs (yaxuwDuwA fiy, musta>onisiyna li). Separately, Form IV does NOT entail communication: 65:1 originates an >amr (a matter), not an utterance.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 65:1:38:1 — laEal~a All~aha yuHodiTu baEoda *aalika >amoraF ('perhaps Allah will bring about after that a matter'): the thing brought newly into being is an >amr (a non-verbal affair/decree), carrying zero communicative content. This falsifies any attempt to unify the whole root under a communicative 'discourse/account' nucleus and, together with the discourse family's indifference to newness, blocks a single root-level nucleus — forcing the origination family to be reported as an unbridged, resistant class.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A single diachronic nucleus 'coming-to-be / being-brought-forth', yielding origination (Form IV) and 'the brought-forth utterance' = report (noun + Form II), with newness as the unifying thread; its best support is Form IV twice taking *ikorFA (a mention) as object (18:70, 20:113) and muHodaT twice qualifying *ikor (21:2, 26:5), placing 'produce a mention' a hair from 'tell about it'. internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge on a clean morphology-meaning segregation with zero crossover: every discourse/report sense is carried by the bare noun or Form II (31/36), and every origination sense by Form IV or the muHodaT participle (5/36); no Form IV means 'report' and no noun/Form II means 'originate'. The discourse family is broad, distinctive and adversarially clean (spans revelation, secrets, idle talk, fabricated and truthful speech, oral and written), which supports a PREFERRED claim above WEAK. But (a) a coherent resistant derivational sub-class exists (Form IV origination), and (b) at least one materially resistant occurrence (65:1 >amr) shows the origination sense is non-communicative and cannot be folded in. Per the contract's capping rule a resistant derivational sub-class plus material resistance caps the family claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and forbids STRONG/UNIVERSAL. candidate_root_contribution: In its nominal (Hadiyv-/>aHaAdiyv-) and Form-II (Had~ava) family, root Hdv contributes: a unit of communicated discourse — an account/report/statement/tidings, i.e. the told-content about a subject (including the revealed discourse) — and, in Form II, the act of conveying such a discourse to a hearer. The contribution is truth-neutral, novelty-neutral, register-neutral and medium-neutral: value comes from context, not from the root. This family-scoped claim deliberately EXCLUDES the Form-IV family (>aHodava / muHodav), whose sense is origination/bringing-newly-into-being and which is NOT Quran-internally bridged to the discourse sense.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 36/36 occurrences read from the packet; distribution N=28 (bare noun), N(IV)=2 (muHodaT), V(II)=3, V(IV)=3, with objects verified: *ikor (18:70,20:113,21:2,26:5), >amr (65:1), >axobaAr (99:4), persons+bi- (2:76).
layer_attribution.derivation: Form II (Had~ava) is the denominal verbal correlate of the noun (relate an account); Form IV (>aHodava) is the causative 'bring newly into being' with participle muHodaT; the noun is the faEiyl pattern HadiyT/>aHaAdiyT. Morphology and meaning co-segregate with zero crossover.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Nominal + Form-II discourse/account class (31 occ) vs Form-IV origination class (5 occ); jaEalonaAhum >aHaAdiyTa (23:44/34:19) is a mild 'made-into-bywords' idiom within the discourse class, not a separate root sense.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Contextual identifications — 'the best HadiyT' = the Book (39:23), 'this HadiyT' = the revelation (18:6, 56:81), 'lahowa AlHadiyT' = misleading talk (31:6) — are supplied by context and must NOT be elevated into the root claim; the root contributes only 'told-content/account', truth- and register-neutral.

layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The Form-IV origination family is NOT Quran-internally bridged to the discourse family; 65:1 (>amr) is materially non-communicative. hard_case_representation.rationale: The Form-IV origination family (5 occ) persists as a coherent resistant class that the Quran does not bridge to the discourse family; 65:1 (>amr) is a materially resistant occurrence, and the 12:x taical>aHaAdiyT set is an adversarial boundary retained only on the narrowest reading. These resistances are real, recorded here and in counterevidence, and are exactly what caps the family claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and leaves root-level unity unresolved.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Form-IV token (>uHodiTa/yuHodiTu) or a muHodaT participle that Quran-internally means 'narrate/report a HadiyT' (or governs a hearer as Form II does), OR a nominal HadiyT that Quran-internally denotes 'a thing newly brought into being' independent of speech — either would show the discourse family and the origination family share one active nucleus and that the REPRESENTATIVE discourse-family scope is mis-drawn.
rejection_condition.search_location: The Form-IV cluster (18:70:9:1, 20:113:12:1, 65:1:38:1, 21:2:7:1, 26:5:7:1) and the boundary nominals (12:6:7:2, 12:21:23:2, 12:101:9:2 taical>aHaAdiyT; 23:44:15:1, 34:19:9:1 jaEalonaAhum >aHaAdiyTa).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each token's object and argument frame Quran-internally: does Form IV ever take HadiyT/>aHaAdiyT as object or govern a hearer with -hum / bi-? Does any nominal HadiyT denote inception rather than told-content? Compare against the settled frames in clusters A and B.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude the diachronic newness->news etymology and all lexicon/tafsir glosses; hold truth-value, register and medium constant (already shown neutral) so the test isolates inception vs communicated-content rather than context, and do not treat Form IV's *ikor object as proof of 'telling'.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If confirmed, clusters A and B collapse into one nucleus and the family-scoped claim is superseded by a ROOT_GENERALIZATION reading; if disconfirmed, the discourse-family claim stands at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and the Form-IV origination family remains an unbridged resistant class.

reopen_conditions: If any Form-IV occurrence (18:70:9:1, 20:113:12:1, 65:1:38:1) or muHodaT participle (21:2:7:1, 26:5:7:1) is shown Quran-internally to take a HadiyT/account object or to mean 'narrate/report', reopen: the A/B split would collapse toward a unified 'bring-forth-an-utterance' nucleus.

If taical>aHaAdiyT (12:6:7:2, 12:21:23:2, 12:101:9:2) is shown Quran-internally to denote dreams/events rather than narrated accounts, reopen to split a lexicalized >aHaAdiyT='dream-narratives' sub-class out of the discourse family.
If 65:1:38:1 yuHodiTu >amorFA is shown to carry communicative content, reopen the Form-IV origination cluster's boundary against the discourse family.
